report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but current gateway telemetry is healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 74ms, zero dependency timeouts, zero db pool waiters, all spans OK/200. This contradicts the alert hypothesis and no downstream service telemetry is available. No evidence-supported root-cause candidate can be established; handing off for broader telemetry collection.
